wiki.title: Adam Gomez
wiki.extract: Adam Gomez is an American politician who serves in the Massachusetts Senate representing the Hampden District. Prior to his election in 2020, Gomez previously represented Ward 1 as a councillor on the Springfield City Council, first taking office in January 2016. In January 2020, he was selected as vice president of the council.
